name: com.nekuzaky.horror-ai-manager
description: Enemy AI for horror games. Enemies see with a view cone and a suspicion gauge that fills slowly in the dark and fast in the light, hear noises through walls, remember where you were, and patrol, investigate, search and chase you with a deterministic state machine. Events for every scare, plain-word inspectors, Scene view gizmos, a live debug window, and zero garbage per frame.

samples.description: A small dark greybox level with a patrolling enemy, a few lamps, noisy props and a first-person player with a flashlight (F) and crouch (C). Try to sneak past it.
